utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-fourth. Everyone on Teams? I've got seven little boxes and about three actual faces.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, here. Traffic on the ring road was ridiculous. Spent longer looking at the factory than getting into it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely start. Anyone's weekend plans survive the weather? Mine involved sitting outside, so obviously that didn't happen.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: We managed about ten minutes before the rain. Very British, eating under a garden umbrella.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, was muted. Morning. Heard the rain bit, which probably covers the whole weekend.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get distracted completely, what's already finished? Keep that separate from what we're agreeing today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, finished the repair on the GT1 last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. That was the finished one in the handover, then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep. And I signed off the inspection on the water system on Tuesday. That's historical as well, not something outstanding.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah? Just making sure I'm reading the right bit.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah. Already signed off.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the Atlas last night. That's another completed one, nothing new off that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, those stay in the done column.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only an observation from me: noticed the main conveyor was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Settled back down, did it? Not still creeping up?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, it settled. I'm not raising a job for today off it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, I heard a slight rattle from the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Neither of those is a new action this morning.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the newer turbine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, still blocked then. No new delivery date to put against it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And still waiting on parts for the relief valve. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, both parked as blocked. Not pretending they're jobs we can get through today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: One more to keep off the list: we were going to replace the belt on the turbine one, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, cancelled out of today's work. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, actual commitments now. What's the smaller inspection you've got in mind?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll inspect the power pack on one for leaks tomorrow. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just the leak inspection, not rolling a repair into it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, just inspect the power pack on one for leaks. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Ash. Tomorrow, low priority. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya Raman, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the old turbine at half two? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the old turbine at half two.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's the permit and isolation we're talking about, rather than adding any turbine work onto it?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Permit to work and isolation, that's my bit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. It matters but it's not urgent, so no need to treat it as a drop-everything job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And safety Grace, can you write up the near miss at the pop valve for tomorrow at 9:30? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll write up the near miss at the pop valve. Tomorrow at 9:30, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped slightly there. Nine thirty tomorrow for the write-up?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's right, tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. That's the top-priority one, even though the due point is tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ash, can you grease and check the bearings on the hot bearing? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, no, sorry, I can't take that one on. Don't put the hot bearing against me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fair enough. Boss, can you take the hot bearing instead, grease and check the bearings?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead of Ash. I'll grease and check the bearings on the hot bearing. Not an emergency but don't let it slip, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we haven't attached a particular time to that one, have we?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, no particular deadline agreed for that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: There you go. Proof the boss does occasionally get out of Teams.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Occasionally. Usually when somebody's hidden the charger.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the boiler safety valve tomorrow. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, separate from my near-miss write-up. Don't want those two getting muddled just because they're both paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. Mine's the risk assessment for work on the boiler safety valve, normal priority, tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Mide. That one's yours.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Two separate entries, then. Risk assessment normal priority; near-miss write-up top priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, that's it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any crossed wires on those before we finish?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, I'm clear. The old turbine, permit to work and isolation at half two.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I've got the power pack on one for leaks tomorrow, low priority. Not the hot bearing.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'm clear too. The pop valve near miss written up tomorrow at 9:30, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, the hot bearing is with me now, not Ash.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the boiler safety valve risk assessment is with me for tomorrow, normal priority. All good.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Blocked items stay blocked, finished stuff stays finished, and the belt replacement isn't on today's list. That all ties up.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Excellent. If only the ring road could organise itself that well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Wouldn't get your hopes up. Right, thanks everyone. That's us.
